item.title: Arkansas church helps eliminate $18 million in medical debt
item.description: First Presbyterian Church in Fort Smith, Arkansas has partnered with Undue Medical, a national nonprofit organization, to erase $18 million in medical debt for residents in Sebastian and Crawford counties. For every $1 raised by the church, Undue Medical eliminated $100 in medical debt.

item.title: Fine Friday, soggy Saturday, marvelous Monday
item.description: Friday will be a mix of sun and clouds with temperatures climbing into the 60s, followed by light rain and cooler temperatures through Saturday, and then sunny skies and mild temperatures on Sunday, with a warm and windy pattern expected to return next week.

item.title: 'If we lose that, I will have to leave work'; Families worried as Governor proposes budget cuts for disability funding
item.description: Governor Kehoe's proposed fiscal budget for 2027 includes suggested cuts to disability services, which could impact home care for children with developmental disabilities, leading to concerns from parents and advocates.
